task.description:
Draft all new requirements from docs/addon-1/ into docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md. The source documents define Stages 6.5 through 11 plus adaptation requirements (ADP-*).

KEYCLOAK VERSION NOTE: The identity provider is Keycloak. Use the current version (26.x / latest Apache 2.0 OSS edition). Do NOT reference legacy Keycloak versions or WildFly-based distributions. All Keycloak Admin REST API references must target the current Quarkus-based distribution.

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Read docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md to understand the existing format, requirement ID numbering convention, stage structure, and acceptance criteria style.
2. Read all three addon-1 documents.
3. Append new stages (6.5 through 11) and all ADP-* adaptation requirements to docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md, following the exact same format as existing requirements. Do NOT modify any existing requirement.
4. Each requirement MUST have: stable ID, title, description (MUST/SHOULD/MAY), priority, and acceptance hints. IDs from the addon-1 documents (OIDC-*, DSL-*, LUA-*, WASM-*, REPO-*, SIM-*, ADP-*, XC-*) are already assigned — use them as-is.
5. The cross-cutting XC-01..XC-06 requirements should be added as a "Cross-Cutting Requirements" section after Stage 11.
6. Add an updated requirement count appendix reflecting all new requirements.
7. The interpretation rules (IR-01..IR-09) from 03-extension-adaptations.md should be appended as a separate section titled "Extension Interpretation Rules".

REWORK 1 — Fix the following 4 issues identified by REQ-VALIDATOR:
- [MINOR] LUA-03: LUA-03 removal list omits os.execute (if reachable). Source doc explicitly lists it alongside string.dump, loadstring, load, loadfile, dofile. Security-relevant sandbox escape path — must be included.
- [MINOR] OIDC-08: Third acceptance criterion uses vague term "appropriate defaults". Must specify concrete values: missing email defaults to empty string, missing roles claim defaults to empty list.
- [MINOR] SIM-10: "Sufficient information" is unmeasurable. Replace with explicit field list: which assertion failed, expected value, actual value, full event trace to failure point, variable state snapshot at that point.
- [MINOR] Appendix A: Four incorrect rows: Stage 6.5 (31 MUST / 3 SHOULD not 30/4), Stage 8 Lua (16 not 14), Stage 9 Wasm (12 MUST / 2 SHOULD not 13/1), ADP row (14 total not 12, ADP-04a and ADP-04b not counted). Grand total is consequently wrong.
acceptance_criteria: All OIDC-01..OIDC-34 requirements appear in the document with correct IDs and format
All DSL-01..DSL-13 requirements appear with correct IDs and format
All LUA-01..LUA-16 requirements appear with correct IDs and format
All WASM-01..WASM-14 requirements appear with correct IDs and format
All REPO-01..REPO-14 requirements appear with correct IDs and format
All SIM-01..SIM-10 requirements appear with correct IDs and format
All ADP-01..ADP-12 adaptation requirements appear with correct IDs and format
All XC-01..XC-06 cross-cutting requirements appear with correct IDs and format
No existing requirement is modified or removed
Keycloak references use current 26.x / Quarkus-based distribution only
Requirement count appendix is updated to include all new requirements
IR-01..IR-09 interpretation rules section is appended

result.summary: Fixed all 4 REQ-VALIDATOR issues in docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md: (1) LUA-03 now includes os.execute (if reachable) in the sandbox removal list; (2) OIDC-08 third acceptance criterion now specifies concrete defaults (empty string for email, sub value for preferred_username, empty list for roles); (3) SIM-10 acceptance criterion now enumerates explicit fields required in failure diagnostics; (4) Appendix A counts corrected to Stage 6.5 31 MUST/3 SHOULD, Stage 8 16 MUST, Stage 9 12 MUST/2 SHOULD, ADP 13 MUST/1 SHOULD/14 total, Grand Total 169/21/1=191.

issues_resolved.description: Added os.execute (if reachable) to the sandbox must-remove list alongside string.dump, loadstring, load, loadfile, dofile.
Replaced vague "appropriate defaults" with concrete values: missing email defaults to empty string; missing preferred_username defaults to the sub value; missing roles claim defaults to empty list.

Replaced unmeasurable "sufficient information" with explicit field enumeration: which assertion failed (assertion ID/type), expected value, actual value, full event trace up to the failure point, and instance variable state snapshot at that point.

Corrected Stage 6.5 to 31 MUST/3 SHOULD, Stage 8 to 16 MUST/0 SHOULD, Stage 9 to 12 MUST/2 SHOULD, ADP to 13 MUST/1 SHOULD/14 total (counting ADP-04a and ADP-04b). Grand Total corrected to 169 MUST/21 SHOULD/1 COULD=191.
